what: A six-year Patreon creator announces moving to Substack, stating Patreon is a platform for paying creators but not a blogging platform, while Substack is designed as one and is more intuitive for readers.
verbatim_snippet: "In a nutshell, Patreon is a platform for paying content creators of all types, but it's not really a blogging platform. Substack is designed as a blogging platform, and it's much more intuitive for readers to use as well."
notes: Third-party comparative (sub-type b). Speaker: Emily Smucker (creator). Other platform: Substack. Dimension: platform design for writers, reader experience. Disclosed affiliation: Active Patreon creator for 6+ years, migrating to Substack. Text from search engine snippet of a Patreon creator post. Represents a creator's comparative voice hosted on Patreon itself.
